_meta.license: Original art made for this game (game_dev_sprites). Owned outright — free to ship. No third-party pack was used as input.
_meta.placement: Draw over the floor layer, one cell per pillar. There is no overhead variant: a pillar is always seen in elevation, because a cap that does not fill its cell cannot stack above a shaft. A taller hall wants a second face row, not a cap.
_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED by scripts/build_sprite_reference.mjs against the PNG header (64x64 / 32 = 2x2, 4 frames, no remainder). Generated from magma/dungeon_pillars.json — do not hand-edit; re-run the script instead. Frame names are the exporter's own, kept verbatim so a re-export cannot drift from the reference.
